t.zh: 一排高矮不一的柱子。从左往右挑出几根，要求一根比一根高，中间可以跳过。最多能挑几根？
t.en: A row of posts of different heights. Pick some from left to right so that each is taller than the one before; you may skip posts in between. What is the most you can pick?

t.zh: 每一格记：以这一根结尾，最多能连几根。整排的答案，就是这一行里最大的那个。
t.en: Each cell records: ending with this post, the longest run you can make. The answer for the whole row is the largest cell in the row.

t.zh: 只看最后一根：它前面接的是哪一根？可以是前面任何一根，只要比它矮。前面有几根，来路就可能有几条。这正是扫描臂的活儿：它把前面每一格（每一根柱子下面记着的答案）一起送进来。
t.en: Look only at the last post: which post comes before it? It can be any earlier post, as long as it is shorter. However many posts come before, that is how many ways in there may be. That is exactly the sweep arm’s job: it brings in every earlier cell (the answer recorded under each post) at once.

t.zh: 最左边那个「起」格，当它是一根比谁都矮的柱子，存着 0：接在它后面，就表示这一根是第一根。这台机器的扫描臂带着筛选：只留比这一根矮的柱子，筛掉的格子在视野里是暗的。
t.en: Treat the “S” cell on the far left as a post shorter than all the others, holding 0: coming after it means this post is the first. This machine’s sweep arm has a filter: it keeps only the posts shorter than this one, and the cells it drops are dimmed in the view.

goal.zh: 从左往右挑柱子，要一根比一根高（可以跳过）。算出每根柱子作为最后一根时最多能连几根，整排的答案是其中最大的。
goal.en: Pick posts from left to right, each taller than the last (skipping is allowed). For each post, work out the longest run that ends with it; the answer for the row is the largest of these.

how.zh: 这一关会检查整行。扫描臂只送来比这一根矮的柱子，被筛掉的格子是暗的。
how.en: This level checks the whole row. The sweep arm only brings in posts shorter than this one; the cells it filters out are dimmed.

hints.zh: 这一根前面可以接任何一根，只要比它矮：点扫描臂，它只会送来比这一根矮的柱子。
hints.en: This post can follow any post shorter than it: click the sweep arm, and it brings in only the posts shorter than this one.

hints.zh: 在留下的格子里挑最大的，再算上这一根自己：取较大，然后 + 1。
hints.en: Pick the largest of the cells that remain, then count this post itself: max, then + 1.

body.zh: 这一格的来路不再是固定的一两格，而是前面所有符合条件的格子，有几条要看数据。
body.en: This cell’s ways in are no longer one or two fixed cells, but every earlier cell that meets the condition, and how many there are depends on the data.

body.zh: 这个问题叫<wiki-ref to="lis"></wiki-ref>：从一串股价里最多挑出几天、一天比一天高，一堆版本最多能排出多长的升级路线，用的都是它。
body.en: This problem is called the <wiki-ref to="lis"></wiki-ref>: the most days you can pick from a run of share prices with each day higher than the last, or the longest upgrade path through a pile of versions, both come down to it.

note.zh: 来路可以是一整段：在所有比我矮的格子里取最大，再 + 1。
note.en: The way in can be a whole run: take the max over the cells of every shorter post, then + 1.
